name: PegaBall buyGamesFrom pays vendor cuts from the pool
summary: PegaBall's buyGamesFrom never checked msg.value: it only required the caller's wallet balance to cover the price, 'paid' the price by sending the proxy's own ETH to itself, then paid the vendor and referrer cuts from the pool. A self-registered vendor looped it to drain the proxy's ETH.
notes: The campaign tx is a copycat months later; together with the anchor these are the only buyGamesFrom calls that took ETH out of the proxy.
